items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 04 July 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the south of Ireland as a waving frontal zone affects the north of the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the east at first, falling force 3 in places later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the east.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, patchy rain or drizzle.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east.


##State of Sea##

Slight, perhaps moderate in the east at times.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of drizzle in places.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any drizzle.
